description: This file appears to be a C header file (.h) defining the interface for fsmonitor low-level operations, including functions for reading, writing, adding, removing, tweaking, and refreshing fsmonitor extensions within an index. It also declares related structures and external references.

methods.name: read_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Reads the fsmonitor index extension and optionally restores the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state.

methods.name: fill_fsmonitor_bitmap
methods.description: Fills the fsmonitor_dirty ewah bits from the index's current state.

methods.name: write_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Writes the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state into the fsmonitor index extension.

methods.name: tweak_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adds or removes the fsmonitor extension based on current configuration.

methods.name: refresh_fsmonitor
methods.description: Runs the configured fsmonitor integration script to update the index and invalidate cache as needed.

methods.name: fsmonitor_is_trivial_response
methods.description: Determines if the fsmonitor response is trivial.
